verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted URL-to-Markdown and search API. Users tune each request with headers such as x-engine, x-wait-for-selector and x-json-schema, but nothing in the evidence shows the platform letting developers write, upload, or deploy their own scraping scripts. Hosting custom scraping code is a fair question for a scraping service, so the axis applies. Per-request options and the self-hostable Docker image are adjacent features, not hosted custom-script deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
